sentences.text: Issue notice.
Ms. Pratima N. Lakra, learned Central Government Standing Counsel, accepts notice on behalf of respondent No. 4.
She states that she will also take instructions on behalf of respondent No. 1, or ensure that respondent No. 1 is otherwise represented on the next date of hearing.
Respondent Nos. 2 and 3 be served by all permissible modes.
Learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to serve them by email within one week from today and file an affidavit of service, within one week thereafter.

4. Respondent Nos. 1 and 4, which conducted the disciplinary proceedings, are directed to file affidavits within two weeks, clearly answering the petitioner's contention with regard to the opportunity to cross-examine the witnesses.
The record of the disciplinary proceedings will also be produced on the next date of hearing.

5. List in the category of "For Admission Matters" on 08.04.2025.
